evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from Frieza (1st Form)'s Lesson 2. The user launches a disc-shaped projectile; pressing the input again after roughly one second redirects/tracks the disc toward the opponent. The dedicated current documentation reports about 7% damage per successful disc hit, and the user cannot guard while controlling the projectile.
